title: ruellia costaricensis
intro: Ruellia costaricensis, commonly known as Costa Rican petunia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Ruellia costaricensis include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
